name: Saptarshi Debnath
hero_description: Driving technical excellence and scalable architectures in Big Tech Public Sector environments.
summary: Technical Architect and Staff Engineer specializing in the design, scaling, and modernization of high-latency, cloud-native distributed systems. Proven track record of leading architectural transformations, driving organizational engineering standards, and delivering resilient, zero-trust infrastructure at enterprise scale.
